The test image shows a tomato plant with:
- Leaves covered in a whitish/silvery, dusty powdery coating on the upper surface
- Pale, bleached appearance across leaf surfaces
- Some marginal browning and slight leaf curl
- Diffuse, chalky-white residue pattern across multiple leaves

This strongly suggests **Powdery Mildew**. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference image confirms: white powdery coating on tomato leaf surfaces, matching the test image precisely. Both show the characteristic chalky-white dusty residue on the upper leaf surface.
